reference_sql:
WITH ga4 AS (
  -- one row per first-touch source and medium: the export's side. Every sign_up and purchase event
  -- on the Dublin days of Q4 2025 counts once, the consent-denied ones and the server's included
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source,
         traffic_source.medium AS medium,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'sign_up') AS ga4_signups,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_name = 'purchase') AS ga4_first_payments
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('sign_up', 'purchase')
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251231'
  GROUP BY traffic_source.source, traffic_source.medium
),
first_session AS (
  -- one row per visitor: the start of the visitor's earliest session, over every session
  SELECT visitor_id, MIN(session_start) AS first_start
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY visitor_id
),
first_touch AS (
  -- one row per visitor: the UTM source and medium of that first session, (direct) and (none) when missing
  SELECT s.visitor_id,
         COALESCE(s.utm_source, '(direct)') AS source,
         COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium
  FROM sessions AS s
  JOIN first_session AS f
    ON f.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
   AND f.first_start = s.session_start
),
first_payments AS (
  -- one row per subscription: its earliest payment, a refunded one included
  SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY subscription_id
),
backend_rows AS (
  -- one row per backend sign-up or first payment on the Dublin days of Q4 2025, with the visitor who signed up:
  -- signups by the Dublin day of signup_ts, first payments by the Dublin day of the earliest paid_at
  SELECT visitor_id, 'signup' AS kind
  FROM signups
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.visitor_id, 'first_payment' AS kind
  FROM first_payments AS fp
  JOIN subscriptions AS sub ON sub.subscription_id = fp.subscription_id
  JOIN signups AS g ON g.user_id = sub.user_id
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Dublin', fp.first_paid_at) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
backend AS (
  -- one row per first-touch source and medium: the backend's side
  SELECT t.source, t.medium,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.kind = 'signup') AS backend_signups,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.kind = 'first_payment') AS backend_first_payments
  FROM backend_rows AS b
  JOIN first_touch AS t ON t.visitor_id = b.visitor_id
  GROUP BY t.source, t.medium
)
SELECT COALESCE(g.source, b.source) AS source,
       COALESCE(g.medium, b.medium) AS medium,
       COALESCE(g.ga4_signups, 0) AS ga4_signups,
       COALESCE(b.backend_signups, 0) AS backend_signups,
       COALESCE(g.ga4_first_payments, 0) AS ga4_first_payments,
       COALESCE(b.backend_first_payments, 0) AS backend_first_payments
FROM ga4 AS g
FULL OUTER JOIN backend AS b
  ON b.source = g.source
 AND b.medium = g.medium
ORDER BY source, medium

  FROM payments

counted AS (
  -- one row per sign-up or first payment on either side, with its first-touch source and medium:
  -- the export's events by event_date, the backend's rows by their Dublin day
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium,
         CASE WHEN event_name = 'sign_up' THEN 'ga4_signup' ELSE 'ga4_first_payment' END AS what
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('sign_up', 'purchase')
    AND event_date >= '20251001'
    AND event_date <= '20251231'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.source, t.medium, 'backend_signup' AS what
  FROM signups AS g
  JOIN first_touch AS t ON t.visitor_id = g.visitor_id
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Dublin', g.signup_ts) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.source, t.medium, 'backend_first_payment' AS what
  FROM first_payments AS fp
  JOIN subscriptions AS sub ON sub.subscription_id = fp.subscription_id
  JOIN signups AS g ON g.user_id = sub.user_id
  JOIN first_touch AS t ON t.visitor_id = g.visitor_id
  WHERE fp.first_paid_day BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT source, medium,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE what = 'ga4_signup') AS ga4_signups,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE what = 'backend_signup') AS backend_signups,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE what = 'ga4_first_payment') AS ga4_first_payments,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE what = 'backend_first_payment') AS backend_first_payments
FROM counted
GROUP BY source, medium
ORDER BY source, medium

WITH ga4 AS (
  -- one row per first-touch source and medium: the export's sign_up and purchase events on the Dublin days of Q4 2025
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium,
         SUM(CASE WHEN event_name = 'sign_up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ga4_signups,
         SUM(CASE WHEN event_name = 'purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ga4_first_payments
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('sign_up', 'purchase')
    AND event_date >= '20251001'
    AND event_date <= '20251231'
  GROUP BY traffic_source.source, traffic_source.medium
),
q4_signups AS (
  -- one row per signup whose Dublin day, written in event_date's own form, falls in Q4 2025
  SELECT user_id, visitor_id
  FROM signups
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', signup_ts), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251231'
),
q4_first_payments AS (
  -- one row per subscription whose earliest payment falls on a Dublin day of Q4 2025, a refunded one included
  SELECT subscription_id
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY subscription_id
  HAVING strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', MIN(paid_at)), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251231'
),
backend_rows AS (
  -- one row per backend sign-up or first payment, with the visitor who signed up
  SELECT visitor_id, 1 AS is_signup, 0 AS is_first_payment
  FROM q4_signups
  UNION ALL
  SELECT g.visitor_id, 0 AS is_signup, 1 AS is_first_payment
  FROM q4_first_payments AS fp
  JOIN subscriptions AS sub ON sub.subscription_id = fp.subscription_id
  JOIN signups AS g ON g.user_id = sub.user_id
),
visitor_first AS (
  -- one row per visitor of backend_rows: the start of the earliest session over all of the visitor's sessions
  SELECT visitor_id, MIN(session_start) AS first_start
  FROM sessions
  WHERE visitor_id IN (SELECT visitor_id FROM backend_rows)
  GROUP BY visitor_id
),
backend AS (
  -- one row per first-touch source and medium: the backend's side
  SELECT COALESCE(s.utm_source, '(direct)') AS source,
         COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium,
         SUM(b.is_signup) AS backend_signups,
         SUM(b.is_first_payment) AS backend_first_payments
  FROM backend_rows AS b
  JOIN visitor_first AS v ON v.visitor_id = b.visitor_id
  JOIN sessions AS s ON s.visitor_id = v.visitor_id AND s.session_start = v.first_start
  GROUP BY COALESCE(s.utm_source, '(direct)'), COALESCE(s.utm_medium, '(none)')
),
all_groups AS (
  -- one row per source and medium found on either side
  SELECT source, medium FROM ga4
  UNION
  SELECT source, medium FROM backend
)
SELECT a.source, a.medium,
       COALESCE(g.ga4_signups, 0) AS ga4_signups,
       COALESCE(b.backend_signups, 0) AS backend_signups,
       COALESCE(g.ga4_first_payments, 0) AS ga4_first_payments,
       COALESCE(b.backend_first_payments, 0) AS backend_first_payments
FROM all_groups AS a
LEFT JOIN ga4 AS g ON g.source = a.source AND g.medium = a.medium
LEFT JOIN backend AS b ON b.source = a.source AND b.medium = a.medium
ORDER BY a.source, a.medium

solver.query:
WITH ga_s AS (
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, count(*) AS n
  FROM events WHERE event_name = 'sign_up' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251231'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), ga_p AS (
  SELECT traffic_source.source AS source, traffic_source.medium AS medium, count(*) AS n
  FROM events WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251001' AND '20251231'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), first_touch AS (
  SELECT visitor_id,
         COALESCE(utm_source, '(direct)') AS source,
         COALESCE(utm_medium, '(none)') AS medium
  FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start, session_id) AS rn FROM sessions)
  WHERE rn = 1
), b_s AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(f.source, '(direct)') AS source, COALESCE(f.medium, '(none)') AS medium, count(*) AS n
  FROM signups s LEFT JOIN first_touch f ON f.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Dublin', s.signup_ts) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), fp AS (
  SELECT subscription_id, min(paid_at) AS paid_at FROM payments GROUP BY 1
), b_p AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(f.source, '(direct)') AS source, COALESCE(f.medium, '(none)') AS medium, count(*) AS n
  FROM fp JOIN subscriptions sub ON sub.subscription_id = fp.subscription_id
  JOIN signups s ON s.user_id = sub.user_id
  LEFT JOIN first_touch f ON f.visitor_id = s.visitor_id
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Dublin', fp.paid_at) AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), keys AS (
  SELECT source, medium FROM ga_s UNION SELECT source, medium FROM ga_p
  UNION SELECT source, medium FROM b_s UNION SELECT source, medium FROM b_p
)
SELECT k.source, k.medium,
  COALESCE(a.n, 0) AS ga4_signups, COALESCE(b.n, 0) AS backend_signups,
  COALESCE(c.n, 0) AS ga4_first_payments, COALESCE(d.n, 0) AS backend_first_payments
FROM keys k
LEFT JOIN ga_s a ON a.source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.source AND a.medium IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.medium
LEFT JOIN b_s b ON b.source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.source AND b.medium IS NOT DISTINCT FROM k.medium
